messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — quick kickoff for VelaHealth onboarding. Goal: get them to pilot live in 30 days, and surface any early renewal risks. Quick owners + timeline? :wave:
Liam O'Connor: I can own infra handoff + model routing config. ETA for baseline config: 7 days.
Priya Singh: I'll lead enablement: two 60-min sessions (integrations + best practices) and a playbook doc. Suggest week 1 and week 3.
Omar Haddad: I'll handle data onboarding + privacy checklist. Need their CSV sample and data flow diagram by EOD Friday. @Maya can you ping them?
Maya Chen: Pinging them now — sent intro + request for sample. Also flagged that we'll need SOC2 attestation copy.
Ava Rodriguez: I'll set up success criteria metrics in the Console: latency target < 300ms p95, cost-per-1000 tokens target, and conversion of pilot flows (3 success flows). Will create a dashboard tile.
Liam O'Connor: Small config note — recommend enabling prefix caching and a conservative batch size (8) for the pilot to hit latency goals. We can relax later.
Priya Singh: Enablement checklist draft:
```
- Intro + roles (day 0)
- Integration walkthrough (day 3)
- Prompt engineering best practices (day 7)
- Failover & fallback testing (day 10)
- Post-pilot review (day 30)
```
Maya Chen: Risk tags: renewal-risk: medium (customer mentioned budget constraints), exec sponsor TBD, integration complexity: low-medium. Need exec intro before week 2.
Omar Haddad: Data risks: PII in training logs — we'll enable automatic redaction and provide retention options. I'll note required KMS/JIT access in the ticket.
Ava Rodriguez: Capturing feedback loop: we'll use a shared Google sheet for issues + a biweekly 30-min feedback sync. I'll create and share.
Priya Singh: Want to run a short prompt eval set (10 cases) pre/post-change to catch regressions. I'll own prompt set and baseline results.
Maya Chen: Great. Action items (quick):
- Maya: intro to exec + SOC2 copy (today)
- Omar: privacy + KMS tasks (by Fri)
- Liam: infra baseline config (7 days)
- Priya: enablement schedule + eval set (wk1)
- Ava: dash + feedback sheet (48h)
OnboardBot: Meeting scheduled: "VelaHealth - Onboarding Huddle" on 2025-10-03 15:00 PDT (calendar invite sent).
Liam O'Connor: :thumbsup: I'll add the recommended config to the ticket and link the Console dashboard once Ava's tile exists.
Maya Chen: Thanks — I'll follow up after exec intro. If anyone hits blockers, post here and I'll escalate. :eyes:
